research.title: Precision Agriculture with AI: A Deep Dive into ML Applications
research.abstract:
Exploring machine learning applications in modern farming, from crop yield prediction
to pest management. This research examines how AI can optimize agricultural outcomes
while promoting sustainability.

research.title: Conversational AI for Agricultural Consulting
research.abstract:
Investigating the effectiveness of large language models for providing agricultural
consulting services. Includes case studies on JAC-IA deployment in real farming scenarios.

research.title: RAG Systems for Specialized Knowledge Domains
research.abstract:
Building and evaluating Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems for domain-specific
knowledge retrieval, with applications in agricultural intelligence.

research.title: Sustainable Tech Stack for Farm Management Systems
research.abstract:
Analysis of modern development frameworks and their application to building
sustainable, scalable farm management systems.

research.title: Data Privacy in Agricultural Intelligence Systems
research.abstract:
Examining privacy-preserving approaches for agricultural data collection and AI
analysis, with focus on farmer data rights and ethical AI practices.
